docs.text: Alice Chen leads the Atlas team. Atlas builds the ingestion pipeline.
Bob Rao works on Atlas and wrote the Kafka connector.
The ingestion pipeline depends on Kafka and the Schema Registry.
Carol Diaz leads the Beacon team. Beacon owns the Schema Registry.
Dana Kim reports to Alice Chen and maintains the Kafka connector.
Beacon is on call for Schema Registry outages.

qa.q: Who leads the team that owns the Schema Registry?
Which team builds the Ingestion Pipeline?
Who maintains the Kafka Connector and who do they report to?
qa.a: Dana Kim reports to Alice Chen

qa.q: Which team is on call if a dependency of the Ingestion Pipeline owned by another team fails?
